visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Build the word instead of testing three cases
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop has a separate branch for the combined case. Build the text with Fizz and Buzz joined, and use the number when the text is empty. The list must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Joining Fizz and Buzz means FizzBuzz appears by itself, and a new rule (say, 7 gives Pop) is one more line instead of a new combination of cases.

checks.label: The list is right
checks.expr: text('#out') === '1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz'
